Pivya (pivmecillinam) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline

Guideline Name 
Pivya (pivmecillinam)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
5/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Pivya  
Approval Length 
7 Day(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of uncomplicated urinary tract infection (uUTI)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Infection is susceptible to pivmecillinam  


--- PDF page 1334 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1334 
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient is 18 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
4 - Trial and inadequate response, contraindication, or resistance to ONE alternative oral 
antibacterial treatment option (e.g., trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, ciprofloxacin)  
 
AND 
 
5 - Infection is caused by ONE of the following:  
• 
Escherichia coli  
• 
Proteus mirabilis  
• 
Staphylococcus saprophyticus
